rv.q: DEATH BECOMES HER, which runs Oct. 7 through Oct. 11 at the Ohio Theatre, is the rare production that not only captures the magic of the 1992 original film, but expands on the characters Meryl Streep , Goldie Hawn and Bruce Willis created.
That’s effectively matched on stage in this engaging musical version.
Lush visuals, interesting music, a witty script and a timeless theme explored by talent that’s to die for.

Not suited for the little ones, “Death Becomes Her” is an entirely sassy, high-energy and go-for-broke take on the 1992 black comedy fantasy movie directed by Robert Zemeckis and starring Meryl Streep, Goldie Hawn and Bruce Willis.
Overall, this show was amazing, and if you are looking for something fun to do, I would recommend you go see it.
Powered by a quartet of stellar performances, it’s everything you love about musical theater dialed up to an 11.

cn.t: Critics praise this high-energy musical adaptation as a stellar, laugh-filled improvement on the cult classic film, powered by exceptional performances and go-for-broke sass that dials musical theater up to 11.
